# M&M Engineering & Consultancy CC

> Multidisciplinary contracting, civil engineering, building construction, electrical reticulation, instrumentation, and engineering management practice based in Windhoek, Namibia, serving public ministries, town councils, universities, and private developers across Namibia and Southern Africa since 2013.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/): Practice overview, core contracting and engineering disciplines, fleet summary, and statutory standing.
- [About](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/about): Company profile, Windhoek offices, governance structure, and 8 core delivery merits.
- [Services](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/services): 13 multidisciplinary contracting, EPIC procurement, electrical, instrumentation, civil, and clean-energy scopes plus verified plant and 10 kV testing fleet.
- [Consultancy](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/consultancy): Design coordination, HAZOP safety reviews, site supervision, and commissioning support.
- [Projects](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/projects): 25 completed and documented contracts totalling N$ 152.77 million across hospitals, clinics, police stations, university campuses, housing estates, and municipal services.
- [Clients & Partners](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/clients): Ministries, parastatals, municipalities, and consulting engineering firms worked with across Namibia.
- [Safety & OHS Policy](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/safety-policy): Occupational Health and Safety Policy compliant with the Labour Act (Act 11 of 2007) and Government Notice No. 156 of 1992.
- [Company Profile & Policy Manual](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/profile): Interactive web edition and downloadable 15-page A4 corporate profile PDF (`https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/downloads/M_and_M_Company_Profile_and_Policies.pdf`).
- [Journal](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/blog): Technical field notes on EPIC procurement, electrical instrumentation, consulting practice, and site governance.
- [Contact](https://www.mmengineeringcc.com/contact): Tender desk, Windhoek office locations, and project enquiry form.
